scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the studio evaporative-cooler rinse and restore the side access panel before afternoon glazing ventilation checks.
Emerging Need: The rinse has begun, but the pump-strainer panel jams after a screw shears, leaving the open cooler unable to be reseated or cleaned without service help.
Decision Context: Stored cooler notes identify the no-pry rule, model/access details, and approved routine service contact; live route notices narrow the same-day window.
Consequence: Once dispatch locks the Saturday route, the cooler remains partly open and the rinse cannot be completed before the studio work block.

parameter.title: Studio evaporative-cooler rinse
parameter.description: Rinse reservoir and clear pump strainer before the 13:00 glazing ventilation checks.

parameter.content: Starting the studio swamp-cooler rinse now. Winter cover is off, power is switched off, and I’m sliding the side access panel to reach the pump strainer.

Bad turn on the cooler: the upper screw sheared while the side panel was half slid out. The panel is jammed on the flange, the strainer is still behind it, and I can’t get the panel back into the track. Leaving the ladder set and the cooler off.

parameter.subject: Saturday evaporative-cooler route closes at 11:20
parameter.body: For existing residential customers, non-structural panel reseat and pump-access calls reported before 11:20 can still be worked into today’s north Santa Fe route. Include the observed symptom, access notes, and any unit model details. The route board is finalized after that.

parameter.subject: Saturday cooler route finalized
parameter.body: Today’s north-side dispatch board is now locked. New panel-access or pump-strainer requests will be offered Monday morning appointments unless they were already confirmed on the Saturday route.
